notes:
New Features:

- Redlight HD localhost playback now proxies the HLS media requests as well as the manifest, preserving the Origin/Referer headers observed in the Edge browser trace while Kodi keeps one stable localhost URL.
- A local relay preflight validates both the rewritten manifest and the first media bytes before Kodi receives the relay URL; failed relay validation falls back automatically to the known direct child-playlist path.

Improvements:

- Release Notes use substantially more of the available horizontal space in both the post-update window and Settings, reducing unnecessary wrapping and scrolling.
- A transparent focusable scroll surface now covers the Release Notes viewport so mouse-wheel input is routed reliably while keyboard and Yatse keep the same document-wide scrolling behavior.

Bugfixes:

- Fixes Redlight resolving successfully while Kodi still failed with OpenDemuxStream after about 30 seconds because the localhost manifest handed media URLs back to Kodi without the browser-required request headers.
- Fixes Kodi Stat/HEAD receiving a zero-length relay manifest by returning the actual rewritten manifest length.
- Fixes Release Notes wrapping well before the visible right edge and mouse-wheel events not reaching the manual viewport on some Kodi/skin combinations.
